scientific_integrity: The exact finite graph, inverse-temperature range, polynomial normalization, nonzero-field fugacity and fixed-coupling growing-size limit are stated explicitly. The on-circle simplicity and density/peaks follow from analytic phase monotonicity, not numerical tests. Prior Lee–Yang location and star Poisson-kernel laws are acknowledged. No theorem is asserted for infinite lattices or arbitrary heterogeneous decorated graphs.

title: Off-axis Lee–Yang density peaks induced by triangular decoration
